title: Warren River Company

services.name: Warren Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Where to meet: Stanley’s Boat Yard, 17 Barton Ave in Barrington, RI at “A dock”. There is plenty of parking and someone will greet you at the top of the dock (look for our sign!) and then walk you to the boat! Please arrive 20 minutes before your scheduled tour time. Do: Use the restroom before you depart the marina! Come to have an enjoyable time! Bring a light jacket or sweater, it may get cool when the sun goes down. Wear comfortable non marking sole shoes, not heels ladies! Don’t: Show up already three sheets to the wind, you will not be allowed on board…bring enough alcohol/booze for the US Navy, it will stay on land! Smoking of anything is not permitted on our vessels, at the marina

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Warren River Company offers a unique series of boat tours of the waterfront in Warren, RI. Enjoy a narrated, hour long cruise aboard our vintage Dyer Glamour Girl. Maybe a cocktail cruise before dinner or a breathtaking sunset
